business_summary: AVIC Chengdu Aircraft Company Limited manufactures and sells aircraft equipment, aviation component, and intelligent measurement and control products in China and internationally. It offers motor vehicle inspection equipment; sensors and instruments; and weighing control systems. The company also engages in the research and experimental development activities. In addition, it provides military and civil aviation, as well as non-aviation products. The company was formerly known as Zhonghang Electronic Measuring Instruments Co.,Ltd and changed its name to AVIC Chengdu Aircraft Company Limited in January 2025. AVIC Chengdu Aircraft Company Limited was founded in 1965 and is based in Chengdu, the People's Republic of China. AVIC Chengdu Aircraft Company Limited is a subsidiary of Aviation Industry Corporation of China,Ltd.
business_summary_ko: AVIC Chengdu Aircraft Company Limited는 중국 및 해외에서 항공기 장비, 항공 부품, 지능형 측정 및 제어 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 자동차 검사 장비를 제공합니다. 센서 및 기기; 및 계량 제어 시스템. 회사는 또한 연구 및 실험 개발 활동에도 참여하고 있습니다. 또한 군용 및 민간 항공은 물론 비항공 제품도 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Zhonghang Electronic Measurement Instruments Co.,Ltd로 알려졌으며 2025년 1월에 AVIC Chengdu Aircraft Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. AVIC Chengdu Aircraft Company Limited는 1965년에 설립되었으며 중화인민공화국 청두에 본사를 두고 있습니다. AVIC Chengdu Aircraft Company Limited는 중국 항공산업공사(Aviation Industry Corporation of China,Ltd)의 자회사입니다.
